name: watch-subagents: a record that is a link is believed
find: const record = isPlainPath(root, `${RECORDS}/${name}`) ? readRecord(join(root, RECORDS, name)) : undefined;
test: pnpm vitest run kit/hooks/hooks.test.mts -t "does not believe a record that is a link"

mkdirSync(join(root, RECORDS), { recursive: true });
